personality_one_liner: An ultra-luxurious, high-trust digital gold and fine jewellery platform combining editorial elegance with financial utility.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous breathing room. Avoid dense clusters; give high-value actions clear thumb zones.

do's: Use blur on sticky headers over scrolling content
Apply to the live gold/silver price hero cards for cinematic depth
Bottom tab bar needs frosted glass overlay
dont's: Do not blur standard list rows or catalogue item backgrounds
Avoid glass effects on form fields or text inputs

screens.name: Side Drawer Menu
screens.purpose: Primary side navigation providing utility access without interrupting main flow.
screens.layout: Header: Ink (#111827) background, Profile Avatar (initials or photo), Name, Phone, Right Chevron for profile detail. Body: List of menu items on White background with Lucide icons colored Deep Gold (#8A6E1C). Only include: My Orders, My Wallet, Delivery, SIP, Offers, KYC Status, My Address, Logout. Footer: 'For any query contact on <phone>' and 'Powered by <brand>' centered at bottom.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Showcase live prices, portfolio status, and entry points into digital gold and jewellery.

states.loading: Shimmer on price cards and banners
states.error: Toast or inline banner for failed live price fetch

screens.layout: Top Left: Hamburger menu icon opening drawer. Hero: Live gold/silver price cards in Ink (#111827) + Glass, highlighting premium values. Auth check: If logged in, show Wallet balance pill under header; if logged out, hide wallet balance. Categories: Replace circle photos with tinted icon containers (rounded square 'md' radius with Lucide icons) for a cleaner layout. Auto SIP Promo and Trending Banners follow with subtle gradient or cream backgrounds.

screens.name: Catalogue (Jewellery Grid)
screens.purpose: Editorial grid to browse physical jewellery without cropping details.

states.loading: Skeleton grid with shimmering surfaceSecondary blocks
states.empty: Icon + 'No items found' + Clear Filters CTA
states.error: Failed to load catalogue inline error

screens.layout: Two-column grid layout. Product image container: MUST use surfaceSecondary (#FDF8E8 Cream) with `objectFit: 'contain'` ensuring jewellery photos are never cut off. Avoid round images entirely here. Padding: md. Beneath image: Product name, specs, and price with Gold primary text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Drawer Menu specific setup: Ensure left side drawer navigation matches exact user request: Profile block at top (Avatar, name, phone, right chevron), EXACT menu list (My Orders, My Wallet, Delivery, SIP, Offers, KYC Status, My Address, Logout), and Footer with contact number and 'Powered by' branding.
Remove 'Sell' feature from Drawer menu, only include explicitly requested features.
Strictly follow the user's color palette (Gold #D4AF37, Cream #FDF8E8, Deep Gold #8A6E1C, Ink #111827).
Replace ALL circular category photos with tinted square/squircle blocks using lucide-react-native icons.
CRITICAL FIX: On the catalogue grid or detail screens, images MUST use `contentFit="contain"` on a Cream (#FDF8E8) background. Never use `cover` that crops out parts of the jewellery.
Wallet Balance Logic: Add conditional rendering to the wallet balance pill. It must only be visible when the user is signed in.
Apply Glassmorphism (expo-blur) on the live price cards and the bottom tab bar to maintain a premium Luxe feel.
Use 'Inter' font for all typography as explicitly requested, ensuring standard hierarchical sizing (sm to 2xl) without using heavy weights.
